simple.meaning: בָּשֵׁל (bâshêl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “boiled.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

occurrences.englishText: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;
